name: pipeview-vscode
description: Offline interactive reports for GNU Make and GitLab CI pipelines — graphs, variables, What-If simulation — right in the editor, defaulting to the open repository with its git upstream as the reference for cross-repository includes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Report generation runs the pipeview CLI on workspace files (Make enrichment executes `make -pqn`) and --upstream reads the repository's git configuration.

commands.title: GitLab: Report for a Remote Project…
GitHub: Report for a Remote Repository…

pipeview.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter used for the `python -m pipeview` fallback. Empty: `python3` (or `python` on Windows, where the `py` launcher is tried as well).

pipeview.cliPath.markdownDescription: Explicit path to the `pipeview` executable (on Windows e.g. `C:\Users\me\AppData\Roaming\Python\Python312\Scripts\pipeview.exe`). Empty: `pipeview` on PATH, falling back to `python -m pipeview` (and `py -3 -m pipeview` on Windows).

pipeview.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Where generated reports are written. A relative path is resolved from the workspace folder. Empty: the extension's per-workspace storage directory (keeps the repository clean).

pipeview.useUpstream.markdownDescription: Pass `--upstream` when reporting on the repository or a file: cross-repository `include:`s of GitLab CI roots are resolved by fetching them from the GitLab host the repository's own git remote points at (requires an API token — see *Pipeview: GitLab: Set API Token*). Without a token the report still generates; unresolved includes stay dashed ghost nodes.

pipeview.upstreamRemote.markdownDescription: Git remote to use with `--upstream`. Empty: the current branch's tracking remote, else `origin`, else the sole remote.

pipeview.extraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments appended to report invocations (e.g. `--no-enrich`, `-v`).
